high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from a photo editing app, showing a black-and-white filter applied to a photograph. The photograph itself depicts the back of a person's head and neck, with their hair wet and slightly disheveled. The person is standing in what looks like a shower or bathroom, as suggested by the tiled wall in the background. The photo editing interface at the bottom of the screen indicates that the user has selected a "Vista" filter, which is one of several filter options available: Onyx, Eiffel, Vogue, and Vista.
